soundness_flags.label: thm:joint-cfse
soundness_flags.one_line: “Compact subsets of M_T contained in U_rr” is undefined because M_T is a class of triangular-array laws while U_rr is a row-law domain; specify the row-law topology and uniform envelope, moment, and margin bounds over the indexed family.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:joint-cfse through thm:path-bands
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The claims are conditional on fixed T and on the all-active full-rank interior with positive Gram and Schur-residual margins; rank-changing and zero-pivot laws are excluded.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Joint CFSE, parameter inference, and path-band coverage are asserted only uniformly over a precisely specified regular family of row laws lying inside the positive-margin interior.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The AMP update contains an Onsager term and the paper's proof uses conditional Gaussian/projection representations to establish fixed-iteration state evolution.
The paper supplies a nonasymptotic leave-one-out representation for AMP iterates under Gaussian matrices with general variance profiles.

The paper learns a higher-order state-evolution update from mean/variance features to estimate TTE and refers to confidence intervals, while its displayed theory summarizes first-order state evolution rather than a root-N CFSE covariance or coverage theorem.
